# Spec: gauge-rows-opt-in
<!-- Generated by /hefesto:hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-11-09 -->
<!-- Board item: HEF-23 — the status-line gauge shows only context by default; the run rows are opt-in -->
<!-- req-coverage: scoped -->

## Overview

`hooks/context-gauge.sh` prints the context line (`ctx 45% · 90k/200k`, plus `· /compact (<lane>)` past the
lane's threshold) and then, unconditionally, up to six rows from `runs_rows` (`:56–77`, called at `:100`):
`▶ <role> <id> · <age>` per ledger claim, `⏸ <id> · <decision>` per item waiting on a person, and the lane-action
rows (`▶ … · action`, `⏸ … · action: …`), then `… +N more`. Owner decision 2026-11-07: the list in the footer
is not productive. This feature makes those rows opt-in through a new key, `context.gauge_rows` (boolean,
default `false`), in `.claude/project-status.json`. With the key absent or anything but `true`, the gauge prints
the context line only. The pass brief (`/hefesto:hef.orchestrate`) stays the place where runs and decisions are
listed; nothing about it changes.

## Decisions (made here, from the code — no clarification needed)

- **D1 — the key is read from the project folder the rows come from**: `<pdir>/.claude/project-status.json`,
  where `pdir` is the gauge's existing `workspace.project_dir // workspace.current_dir // cwd` (`:91`). That
  is the folder whose ledger `runs_rows` reads, so the switch and the rows it governs agree. `compact_at` keeps
  reading `<current_dir>` as today (out of scope). Inside a linked worktree `pdir` is the worktree folder and
  there is no fallback to the main one (the same as the gauge's existing `.board` read), so a project tracks
  `.claude/project-status.json` for the rows to show in worktrees; the quickstart says so.
- **D2 — only the JSON boolean `true` turns the rows on.** `false`, absent, `null`, the string `"true"`, `1`, an
  unreadable or invalid file, or no file at all → rows off. Off is the default and the safe reading; a status
  line must never fail (`:13`), so a bad value is silently off, never an error.
- **D3 — when off, the ledger is not read at all** (`runs_rows` is not called): the gauge does strictly less
  work per refresh than today.
- **D4 — `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh` writes nothing for the key**, in any mode (`--lanes`, `--strict`,
  `--remove`, `--print`); it only edits `.claude/settings*.json`, and the default is off. Its header comment for
  `statusLine` names the key as the way to add the rows.
- **D5 — docs**: every place that describes the rows under the status line says they are shown only with
  `context.gauge_rows: true`: `docs/quickstart.md` (§"The status line" and the lane-actions bullet),
  `docs/quickstart.pt-BR.md` (same two places), `docs/hooks.md` (`context-gauge.sh` row), the gauge's own header
  comment (`runs:` paragraph), and the `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh` header. A `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` entry
  records the default change (rows were on; now off).
- **D6 — the existing smoke checks of the rows** (`tests/smoke.sh` ~5480–5502 and ~6127–6131) set
  `context.gauge_rows: true` in the fixture project and keep asserting the same rows; new checks cover the
  default-off and invalid-value paths.

## User Scenarios

### US1: By default the gauge shows only the context line [P1]
- **Given** a project whose `.claude/project-status.json` has no `context.gauge_rows` (or no such file), and a
  ledger with a running claim and an item blocked on `human:plan-approval`
- **When** the status line runs the gauge
- **Then** it prints exactly one line, `ctx 12%` (with tokens / `/compact` / the profile's own line as today),
  and no `▶`, `⏸` or `… +N more` row
- **Edge**: `--with-user` → still exactly one line: `<yours> · ctx 12%`
- **Error/negative**: `context.gauge_rows` is `"true"` (string), `1`, `null`, or the file is not valid JSON →
  one line, exit 0, nothing on stderr; the rows must NOT appear

### US2: A project opts in and sees the rows as today [P1]
- **Given** `.claude/project-status.json` with `"context": {"gauge_rows": true}` and the same ledger
- **When** the gauge runs from the main folder or from inside a linked worktree of it
- **Then** it prints the context line followed by `▶ implement RN-1 · 0m` and `⏸ RN-2 · plan approval`, at most
  six rows then `… +N more`, and the lane-action rows — byte-identical to today's output
- **Edge**: `gauge_rows: true` alongside `compact_at` (number or per lane) → both honoured independently
- **Error/negative**: `gauge_rows: true` but no ledger / an empty ledger → the context line only, exit 0

### US3: Setup and docs agree with the default [P2]
- **Given** a project set up with `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh` (any of: no flag, `--lanes`, `--strict`)
- **When** setup finishes
- **Then** `.claude/project-status.json` is untouched and no settings file it writes contains `gauge_rows`
- **And** the docs that describe the gauge's rows say they appear only with `context.gauge_rows: true`
- **Error/negative**: no doc keeps an unconditional "below it, one row per background run" sentence

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `context-gauge.sh` prints the run/decision/action rows only when `<pdir>/.claude/project-status.json` has `.context.gauge_rows` equal to the JSON boolean `true` | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-002 | With the key absent, non-boolean, `false`, or the file missing/invalid, the gauge prints the context line only, exits 0, writes nothing to stderr, and does not read the ledger | P1 | US1 |
| FR-003 | With `gauge_rows: true`, the rows are unchanged from today (claims, human decisions, lane actions, six-row cap, `… +N more`, worktree resolution) | P1 | US2 |
| FR-004 | `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh` writes no `gauge_rows` key anywhere, in any mode | P2 | US3 |
| FR-005 | The gauge header, `hefesto-setup.sh` header, `docs/hooks.md`, `docs/quickstart.md`, `docs/quickstart.pt-BR.md`, `docs/install.md` and the `SETUP.md` template state that the rows are opt-in via `context.gauge_rows` (default false), and no doc keeps the unconditional rows sentence; `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` records it | P2 | US3 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | A ledger with a claim and a human block, no key → gauge output is one line | `tests/smoke.sh` check citing `gauge-rows-opt-in/FR-001`, `/FR-002` |
| SC-002 | `"true"`, `1`, `null`, invalid JSON → one line, rc 0, empty stderr | `tests/smoke.sh` loop over the values |
| SC-003 | `gauge_rows: true` → the existing row assertions (main folder, worktree, six-row cap, hour age, pending action) pass unchanged | existing smoke checks with the fixture opted in |
| SC-004 | Mutation: replacing the `== true` test with an always-true condition makes the default-off check fail; dropping the guard's call makes the opt-in check fail | smoke mutation lines (sed on a copy of the gauge) |
| SC-005 | `grep -rn gauge_rows hooks/hefesto-setup.sh` finds only the header comment; setup leaves `project-status.json` byte-identical | smoke check (cmp before/after setup) |
| SC-006 | Every doc listed in FR-005 mentions `gauge_rows` | smoke grep check |

## Out of Scope

- The pass brief and `/hefesto:hef.orchestrate` output (they keep listing runs and decisions).
- `compact_at` and where it is read from.
- Any per-lane form of `gauge_rows` (a boolean only, per the item).

## Clarifications
_None — every decision was made from the code (see Decisions)._
